liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Spoonful** (1 review, 2 other sources): Reviewer recalls Jerry playing a Russian lullaby-style jam out of Spoonful, which built great anticipation in the crowd; Uploader says the jam out of Spoonful sounds like Nobody's Fault meets Russian Lullaby [9][10][17]
- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Reviewer ranks this Shakedown above Chicago '91 and Oakland '92, with MIDI runs and Jerry adding extra touches to the jam; Reviewer recalls the show opening with a Shakedown Street lasting about fifteen minutes [18][22]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer found it interesting that Greatest Story Ever Told opened the second set [16]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer says the jams coming out of Crazy Fingers, Spoonful and into the Playing reprise are decent [16]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer praises the Space into The Other One as kick-ass and under-mentioned [21]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Reviewer notes the band closed the set with Touch Of Grey even though they could have stopped after Promised Land [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **Touch Of Grey, Set Break**: back after 157 archived shows (728 days); rare: 3 archived performances [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-25.133308.Nak300sSenn441s.Fitzy.Keo.Flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 172 min [1]
- **gd1991-03-25.149547.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 179 min [7]
- **gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 3.36/5 by 11 [8]
- **gd1991-03-25.sbd.miller.87731.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 174 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [9]
- **gd1991-03-25.154463.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 174 min [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says 1991 began the springtime ritual of Knickerbocker shows, which were always wild [19]
- Reviewer says Jerry wore a purple silk shirt that night [21]
- Reviewer recalls buying crystal opium at the show, and remembers Shakedown [24]
- A taper bust occurred at 5:29 of Tennessee Jed [7]
- Reviewer says the Knick run began in March 1990 with three nights; this 1991 run was good but weaker, though sound is great [20]
- Reviewer says this Shakedown is not as good as the one from 6-22-91 [23]
- Playing in the Band is finished from the 23rd, having been started there [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-25.133308.Nak300sSenn441s.Fitzy.Keo.Flac1644**: taped by Fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; 2 Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns + 2 Sennheiser 441's > Unknown Radio Shack Mixer > Sony D5, Tapes:Maxell… [1]. Also: Fitzy's recording used Nak300CP4 and Senn441 microphones through Sony D6, with DSD file transfer lineage from 2015; Patches came from Mr. Baker's masters; some songs have missing starts and ends [1]
- **gd1991-03-25.149547.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital FOB Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer By Charlie Miller Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 12, 2020; source: Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (110°) > Panasonic SV-255 (16/48) Location: FOB three rows in front of soundboard [7]
- **gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd>cass-master>dat>shn [8]. Also: Reviewer says Schoeps recordings of the 1990 Albany shows still available are very nice [21]
- **gd1991-03-25.sbd.miller.87731.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) D [9]. Also: Nakamichi 300/CP4 to DAT to Sound Forge to CD source supplies the opening of It's All Over Now [9]
- **gd1991-03-25.154463.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 3, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [10]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Brotman, Metchick and Noel supplied patch source; 2496 to 1644 conversion [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-03-25 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-03-25-knickerbocker-arena-albany-ny-usa/) [29]

citations.quote_or_claim: This was my first show, and I wish I'd picked a better night. The jams out of Crazy Fingers, Spoonful and into the Playing reprise aren't bad, and it's…
citations.title: Review: Little that's special here. (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.quote_or_claim: I'm still dumbfounded nobody mentions the russian lullabye jam Jerry does out of spoonful. I remember being at this show and the anticipation of the dead doing…
citations.title: Review: Russian Lullabye (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.quote_or_claim: This show ran hot and cold for me. Fist of all, the Shakedown was one of the best I ever saw - I think it tops Chicago '91 and even Oakland '92 (which I have…

citations.author: Skijellifetti
citations.quote_or_claim: Ok, wasn't the best of shows, but certainly wasn't the worst. Some highlights, IMHO, Shakedown, High Time, Crazy Fingers (always a fave), Spoonful>RL Jam. This…
citations.title: Review: At least it started Knickerbocker madness.... (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Brentblack
citations.quote_or_claim: Actually, the Knick maddness started the year before with a 3 night run in March. Unfortunately, those shows were taken down due to the Dozin' at the Knick…
citations.title: Review: Knickerbocker Maddness (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: NicksPicks
citations.quote_or_claim: i'm a little more in favor of this show than most here I guess. we all agree it was a great shakedown! Jerry wore a silk purple shirt this night. you knew it…
citations.title: Review: IMO, a strong show (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: fredg
citations.quote_or_claim: I guess I was at this show too. Are you kidding me? A 15 minute Shakedown to start the show! Great set list, great sound board.
citations.title: Review: It must have been a great weekend (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: dmilks
citations.quote_or_claim: Just a note: Hornsby was absent from all shows from 3-23-91 thru 3-29-91 on this tour. Excellent Sound. Great Performance. Anytime Jerry does a Stagger Lee,…
citations.title: Review: 3-25-91 (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Herbacious
citations.quote_or_claim: All I remember was the Shakedown and the great crystal opium that I scored at this show. Thanks Jerry, you rocked.
citations.title: Review: Shakedown (gd91-03-25.sbd.18376.sbeok.shnf)
